subject.title: fix(reply): add configurable beforeDeliver timeout to prevent lane deadlock (#103684)

question: Should the generic reply dispatcher impose a second fail-closed deadline on the entire composed `beforeDeliver` chain, or should timeout recovery remain owned by the individual hook runners and composers?
rationale: The proposed default changes cross-channel message-delivery semantics and can silently suppress valid long-running replies; repository behavior does not establish that this broad policy is intended.

options.title: Keep timeout owner-scoped
options.body: Identify the hanging hook or composer and enforce recovery through its existing timeout and failure-policy contract without changing generic dispatcher behavior.

options.title: Approve a global deadline
options.body: Define a compatible deadline, timeout-specific outcome and observability, production configuration owner, upgrade behavior, and live proof before merging.

recommendation.title: Keep timeout owner-scoped
recommendation.body: Identify the hanging hook or composer and enforce recovery through its existing timeout and failure-policy contract without changing generic dispatcher behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history-backed owner of the dispatcher lifecycle and composed delivery path where this contract must be decided.
